overall_notes: Engineering discipline is high: tests, CI, build gates, a DB guard, backups, a yield canary, and a candid session log. The product a user meets is thin and sometimes wrong. On a Wednesday it lists 4 events for today and 354 upcoming in total, with 4 exhibitions and 3 films. 65% of event pages have no description, and the ones that do are in English on Greek pages. Two of the three 'tonight' homepage concerts I checked (Kotsiras, Pyx Lax) point to the wrong park, Άλσος Pedion Areos instead of Άλσος Nea Smyrni, and are sold out at the source. Measurement, which INTENT names as focus #1, has no working citation or crawler numbers, and the sensors disagree on basic counts. Highest-leverage fixes: (1) publish facts-only instead of hiding the 193 events flagged by A0 enrichment concerns, and add a factual summary in the page's language to the empty pages; (2) fix venue homonym resolution (Άλσος) and apply the megaron time reset, backed by a sampled source-vs-page diff; (3) wire citation and crawler telemetry into the scoreboard, give every report one population count, and alert on missed deploys and stale sensors.
